name: slide-to-confirm
props: Fires at the end. Return a promise to show a spinner in the thumb; a rejection shakes the track, flashes the danger colour and slides back.
Tinted track with a solid thumb, opt-in two-tone gradient track with a white thumb, transparent track with a tinted hairline, or a 48pt slim track.
Thumb, trail and track colour; only the gradient variant derives a second tone from it.
Auto-reset after this many ms. Otherwise call ref.reset().
Fraction of the track that confirms on release.
Ticks at 25 / 50 / 75 %, success on confirm, error on failure.
Style for the track (merged over its height, radius and colour).
